title: Forgeon
claim: Product Hunt: Forgeon — Create, publish, and experience interactive stories
why_good: A platform to create, publish and play AI interactive stories — rides the interactive-fiction + AI wave with a creator-economy angle.
value: A parent, once per birthday, for a physical keepsake — not a subscription to a story feed.
risk: Personalised children's books is itself a crowded print-on-demand niche; the AI part has to buy something the incumbents cannot, and 'branching' may not be it.
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score

zh.claim: Product Hunt: Forgeon —— 创作、发布、体验互动故事。
zh.why_good: 一个创作、发布、玩 AI 互动故事的平台——踩在互动小说 + AI 浪潮上,带创作者经济角度。
zh.value: 一个家长，一年一次生日，为一件实体纪念品付钱——不是订阅一个故事流。
zh.risk: 个性化童书本身就是拥挤的按需印刷小生意；AI 这部分得买到在位者买不到的东西，而「分支」大概率不是。
zh.hook: 一个想让今晚的睡前故事里有自家孩子的家长——不是一个想写互动小说的爱好者。
zh.does: 做、发、玩 AI 互动故事的平台：你描述一个世界，它变成别人能走进去、还能改的东西。
zh.gap: 它对准的是互动小说爱好者，那是一个小而且早就被服务过的人群——AI Dungeon 和角色扮演类应用几年前就到了。没人把同一套机器对准这样一个人：他不要类型也不要社区，只要一个故事，就今晚，主角是他爱的人。
zh.counter: 互动小说做了四十年一直是个热情但很小的市场，AI 没有把它做大，只是把供给做到了无限——那正好是市场型产品最不需要的。会付钱的那批受众已经被 Character.ai 一类吃掉，而平台经济需要的创作者飞轮，这个拿不到。
zh.differentiator: 砍掉平台和市集，只交付一件东西。一本短的、有插图的分支故事，主角叫孩子自己的名字、里面有孩子自己的涂鸦，十分钟做完，能导出 PDF 或者印成书——家长会留着的那个东西，不是他会刷的那个流。冷启动（中文）：小红书搜「睡前故事 定制」和绘本 DIY 帖，家长本来就在为「印上名字的绘本」付钱；冷启动（英文）：r/Parenting 和 r/DnD 的 kids campaign 帖。
zh.why_use: 睡前想给孩子讲一个「今晚这一个、主角是他」的故事的家长。他拿到的是一本插图完整、能打印的书——一个能放上书架的东西，不是一个要订阅的内容流。
zh.edge: 卡住的是角色一致性：第 18 页那张脸得还是同一个孩子。参考图条件化在今年把这堵墙拆了，这才把「AI 生成故事」从一次性玩具变成家长愿意付钱去印出来的东西。
zh.consumer_angle: 用的人是想把一个故事做成能玩的东西、但不会写代码的普通人。他拿到的是一份别人点开就能玩的互动故事。

hook: A parent who wants tonight's bedtime story to have their kid in it — not a hobbyist who wants to write interactive fiction.
does: A platform for making, publishing and playing AI-driven interactive stories: you describe a world, it becomes something other people can walk through and change.
gap: It is aimed at the interactive-fiction hobbyist, which is a small and already-served audience — AI Dungeon and the character-chat apps got there years ago. Nobody has pointed the same machinery at the person who does not want a genre or a community, just one story, tonight, starring someone they love.
counter: Interactive fiction has been a passionate, small market for forty years and AI has not enlarged it — it has only made the supply infinite, which is the opposite of what a marketplace needs. Character.ai and its clones already own the audience that would pay, and platform economics need a creator flywheel this will not get.
differentiator: Drop the platform and the marketplace; ship one artefact. A short, illustrated, branching story with the child's own name and their own drawings in it, finished in ten minutes and exportable as a PDF or a printed book — the thing a parent keeps, not a feed they browse. Cold start (Chinese): 小红书 搜「睡前故事 定制」and 绘本 DIY threads, where parents already pay for name-personalised picture books; Cold start (English): r/Parenting and r/DnD's 'kids campaign' threads.
consumer_angle: Non-developer user: a parent. Finished thing: a printed, personalised storybook — a deliverable, which is what this board's one exception requires.
why_use: A parent at bedtime who wants one story tonight with their own child in it. What they walk away with is an illustrated, printable book — an object that goes on a shelf, not a subscription to a feed.
edge: The wall was character consistency: the child's face has to be the same face on page eighteen. Reference-image conditioning cleared that this year, which is what moves 'AI story generator' from a novelty demo to something a parent would pay to have printed.
